items.title: How Basketball Was Invented With Peach Baskets #Shorts
items.description: Basketball was invented in December 1891 when teacher James Naismith nailed two peach baskets to a gym balcony in Springfield, Massachusetts. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
items.caption: Basketball started with two peach baskets and a soccer ball. 🏀 Which sport should we cover next? Tell us below.
